'''Myron Samuel Malkin''' (1924 - 1994) was a [[United States of America|U.S.]] [[Business administration|administrator]] and [[physicist]]. Malkin was the father and first director of the [[United States of America|U.S.]] [[Space Shuttle program]] from 1973 to 1980.

Malkin was born in [[Youngstown, Ohio]]. He served in the United States Marine Corp during World War II. He was involved with the US takeover of Iow Jima. He studied at [[Yale University]] eventually earning his Ph.D. there in nuclear physics.
